vulnerability.name: GO-2026-5932
vulnerability.description: golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp is unmaintained and unsafe by design

statements.impact_statement: The advisory affects the golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp package tree, which gomplate does not import. Its only use of golang.org/x/crypto is bcrypt, for the crypto.Bcrypt template function.

vulnerability.name: CVE-2026-116587
vulnerability.description: go-jose: denial of service via crafted RSA parameters in JWKs

statements.impact_statement: go-jose parses JWKs only for the Vault client (the vault: datasource) and for SPIFFE trust bundles (gRPC-based cloud datasources). This image calls gomplate with env: datasources only, so no JWK is ever parsed.

vulnerability.name: CVE-2026-78661
vulnerability.description: golang.org/x/net/html: denial of service via crafted HTML input

statements.impact_statement: The golang.org/x/net/html package is not compiled into gomplate: go list -deps ./cmd/gomplate does not include it, on linux/amd64 or linux/arm64. The module is listed because other x/net packages are linked.
